name: Changi Airport Group (Singapore Changi Airport)

scam_info.sample: Changi Airport Group alerts public of phone scam targetting participants of the 'Be A Changi Millionaire' promotion
scam_info.notes: Only CAG-published scam item found in the 2,211-URL main sitemap (newsroom 2019, datePublished 2019-08-21). Article body appears JS-loaded (curl got title/nav only). No current scam/security page on changiairport.com; recent fake Changi luggage / iShopChangi scams were covered by SPF advisories (2023-12-07, 2023-12-28) not CAG pages.

hotlines: +65 9615 7555 (WhatsApp chatbot, wa.me link on contact page)
apps: iChangi (iOS App Store id391730848; Google Play com.changiairport.cagapp)

notes: official_domains: changiairport.com (b); jewelchangiairport.com (b: official Jewel contact email on CAG contact page). changiairportgroup.com not observed in fetched pages (not added). Contact page also references a CAG Fraud and Ethics (whistleblowing) hotline - internal fraud, not consumer scams.
